snp5.14:1.1:
To the one in jhāna—
seated, dustless,
snp5.14:1.4:
gone to the beyond
of all phenomena—
snp5.14:1.5: I’ve come with a desire for a question.
snp5.14:1.6: Tell me the gnosis of emancipation,
snp5.14:2.3:
both of sensual desires,
& of unhappiness,
snp5.14:3.2:
with inspection of mental qualities
swift in the forefront:
snp5.14:3.3: That I call the gnosis of emancipation,
snp5.14:4.1:
Udaya:
With what
is the world fettered?
snp5.14:4.4:
is there said to be
unbinding?
snp5.14:5.1:
The Buddha:
With delight
the world’s fettered.
snp5.14:5.4:
is there said to be
unbinding.
snp5.14:6.1:
Udaya:
Living mindful in what way
snp5.14:6.2:
does one bring consciousness
to a halt?
snp5.14:6.3:
We’ve come to ask
the Blessed One.
snp5.14:7.3: One living mindful in this way
